content:
Hi everyone,

I am a PhD student working in algebraic geometry (moduli spaces of representations of quivers and noncommutative algebraic geometry). I am new to Lean and would like to learn by making small contributions to mathlib.

Representations of quivers are already in mathlib, but I could not find notions of slope-semistability, Harder-Narasimhan filtrations, etc. Since these are notions I work with on a day-to-day basis, trying to formalise these seems like an obvious starting point for me. Depending on how this goes, I could try to work up to the construction of moduli spaces of representations of quivers through GIT.

Is this a good project to start with or is there something else (related to algebraic geometry) that is more suitable?
It sounds like a good long-term project. Also, it would be great if someone could work out GIT.
